snippet.title: Black Hole Fishing Steam Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Black hole fishing is an absurd incremental game about catching fish. Stock your pond with genetically modified fish, conduct outlandish experiments to discover exotic new fish traits, and go on the fishing journey of a lifetime!

👇 Wishlist Now on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3667390/Black_Hole_Fishing
